related_questions.question: Are online legal forms legitimate?
related_questions.snippet: Usually, yes. In fact, there was a 2023 case in Florida where a landlord used a Rocket Lawyer lease in court and it held up because it was properly signed and matched state requirements. But if you miss a step, like notarization, it can all fall apart. See "Are Online Legal Documents Recognized in Court."
